details.meetingTitle: Client M204 Larkfield MK Thursday Session

summary.executiveSummary: The project review session confirmed the structure for the client presentation, focusing heavily on refining the presentation flow, particularly the handover between speakers and managing audience interaction. Key agreements include a defined timing structure (35 minutes for content, 20 minutes for questions) and specific roles for managing live audience queries. A primary risk identified is the potential for dead air during transitions, which is mitigated by pre-planned ad-lib strategies and technical contingency plans, such as having a backup sharing mechanism. Actions are set for updating slide animations, creating the closing slide with a QR code, and preparing backup questions.

discussion.whatWasDiscussed: Discussion centred on whether to run the entire presentation or spot-check difficult sections, and the structure of the introduction and handover.
discussion.currentPosition: Agreed to spot-check tricky bits to avoid overrunning, focusing on nailing the joins and questions section.
discussion.decisionOrAgreement: Agreed to spot-check tricky bits; the introduction will be brief (around thirty seconds) and the main content will be structured around three key areas.
discussion.dependencyOrRisk: Risk identified regarding the animation on the three-things slide being stripped when pasted as plain text.
discussion.nextStep: Callum is to put the animation back on the three-things slide.

discussion.decisionOrAgreement: Agreed to practise the handover fully; the process involves the presenter opening, housekeeping, covering dead air, and closing.

discussion.nextStep: The team will practise the handover, and the presenter will cover dead air by talking over the gap.
